records.title: Biasiswa Orang Muda Johor (BOMJ)
records.description:
Biasiswa Orang Muda Johor is a full scholarship programme for outstanding Johor students pursuing
higher education. The programme includes preparatory A-Level studies in Malaysia before undergraduate
studies at selected top 20 universities worldwide.
Priority fields include:
Engineering and Technical Studies
Science and Technology
Social Sciences
records.eligibility_criteria:
Applicant and parents must be Malaysian citizens.
Must be born in Johor or have resided in Johor for at least 5 consecutive years.
Minimum 9As in SPM 2025/2026.
Must not exceed 19 years old at the application deadline.
Must be unmarried.
Must pursue full-time studies.
Must not receive another sponsorship for the same study programme.
No household income restriction.
Official Source: https://ypj.gov.my/pages/bantuan/detail/?slug=biasiswa-omj

records.title: Biasiswa Kenangan Dato' Onn (BKDO)
records.description:
Biasiswa Kenangan Dato' Onn is an educational scholarship programme for academically outstanding
Johor students studying in secondary schools.
The programme aims to support deserving students from lower-income families.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be born in Johor or have resided in Johor for at least 5 years.
Must come from a B40 household.
Must achieve at least TP5 or TP6 in a minimum of four core subjects.
Must maintain good academic performance and discipline.
Must be studying in Form 1 to Form 6 at an eligible school in Johor.
Must not receive another scholarship sponsorship, except eligible one-off or small assistance.
Official Source: https://ypj.gov.my/pages/bantuan/detail/?slug=biasiswa-kenangan-dato-onn

records.title: Biasiswa Pasca Siswazah (BPS)
records.description:
Biasiswa Pasca Siswazah is a full scholarship offered by Yayasan Pelajaran Johor to outstanding Johor
students pursuing Master's and PhD studies at Malaysian public universities (IPTA).
The scholarship provides tuition fee assistance and annual living allowances.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must reside in Johor.
Priority is given to applicants born in Johor.
Must be enrolled in a Malaysian public university.
Must be 40 years old or below in the year studies begin.
Must have an unconditional university offer or already be studying.
Must have at least one year of remaining study.
Must pursue full-time studies.
Must not receive other sponsorship for the same study level.
Master's applicants generally require a Bachelor's degree CGPA of 3.75–4.00 or equivalent.
PhD applicants generally require a Master's degree CGPA of 3.75–4.00 or equivalent.
Official Source: https://ypj.gov.my/pages/bantuan/detail/?slug=biasiswa-pasca-siswazah-bps

records.title: Biasiswa IPT Yayasan Pahang (Lepasan STPM)
records.description:
Biasiswa IPT Yayasan Pahang (Lepasan STPM) supports academically outstanding STPM graduates from
lower- and middle-income families pursuing full-time Bachelor's Degree studies at approved Malaysian
public universities.
The programme provides annual financial assistance to help reduce students' living expenses throughout
their studies.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must qualify as an anak Pahang.
Must have obtained 4As or 3As (A/A-) in STPM in the relevant year.
Must come from a B40 or M40 household.
Must have received an offer to pursue a full-time Bachelor's Degree at an approved IPTA.
Must demonstrate good character and health.
Must meet Yayasan Pahang's sponsorship conditions.
Official Source: https://www.yp.org.my/maklumat-biasiswa-yayasan-pahang/

records.title: Biasiswa Anak Yatim Yayasan Pahang
records.description:
Biasiswa Anak Yatim is a scholarship programme introduced by Yayasan Pahang to support orphaned
students from financially disadvantaged households in pursuing tertiary education.
The programme provides financial assistance to eligible students pursuing full-time Bachelor's Degree
studies at Malaysian public universities.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be an anak Pahang.
Applicant, mother and father must be born in Pahang.
Must be an orphan who has lost both parents.
Must have siblings who are still studying.
Guardian's gross household income must not exceed RM4,850 per month.
SPM applicants must obtain at least 5 credits.
STPM applicants must obtain a minimum CGPA of 2.50.
STAM applicants must obtain at least Jayyid Jiddan.
Must receive an offer from a Malaysian public university.
Must pursue full-time studies.
Must have good character and health.
Official Source: https://www.yp.org.my/program-bantuan-pendidikan-yayasan-pahang/biasiswa-anak-yatim/

records.title: Program Khas Biasiswa Selangor Bitara
records.description:
Program Khas Biasiswa Selangor Bitara is a full scholarship programme offered by the Selangor State
Government through TKWBNS.
It supports outstanding candidates pursuing Bachelor's Degree, Master's and PhD studies at 50 leading
universities worldwide, based on the 2026 Times Higher Education or QS World University Rankings by
Subject.
The programme prioritises fields that contribute to Selangor's Smart State development.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Applicant and both parents must be Malaysian citizens.
Applicant or at least one parent must be born in Selangor, or applicant must have resided in
Selangor for more than 10 years.
Open to public servants and members of the public.
Must not exceed 40 years old in the year studies begin.
Minimum CGPA 3.75 or equivalent in the relevant previous qualification.
Must have an offer from an eligible top 50 university in the chosen subject ranking.
Must pursue full-time studies.
Minimum English proficiency: IELTS 6.0, TOEFL 550 or MUET Band 3.0.
Must not receive another education sponsorship.
Research applicants must submit an approved research proposal contributing to Selangor's
development.
Public servants must have at least five years of service in the Selangor State Government
administration.
Private-sector applicants must have at least five years of employment in Selangor.

Water Management

records.title: Biasiswa Khas Dato' Menteri Besar Selangor (Mesir, Jordan & Maghribi)
records.description:
This scholarship supports eligible Selangor students pursuing full-time undergraduate and postgraduate
studies at recognised universities in Egypt, Jordan and Morocco.
The programme focuses on developing graduates in Islamic knowledge, Arabic language and related
disciplines.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Applicant and both parents must be Malaysian citizens.
Must meet the Selangor residency requirements.
Must be registered as a full-time student at a recognised university in Egypt, Jordan or Morocco.
Household income must not exceed RM20,000 per month.
Must not be in the final semester or an extended study period.
Must not receive another scholarship, loan or financial sponsorship.
Must satisfy the specific academic requirements for the selected country and programme.
Academic Requirements
Egypt: Relevant STAM, SPM Arabic and Islamic Studies qualifications.
Other approved programmes: Relevant SPM and Islamic Studies qualifications, subject to the
specific university requirements.
Official Source: https://tkwbns.selangor.gov.my/tkwbns/pembiayaan-pendidikan/bkdmb

records.title: Biasiswa Khas Sagong Tasi (Peringkat Pengajian Tinggi)
records.description:
Biasiswa Sagong Tasi is a special scholarship programme for Orang Asli students from Selangor pursuing
higher education.
The programme provides tuition fee sponsorship and a monthly living allowance to eligible students
studying at public universities throughout Malaysia, Universiti Selangor (UNISEL), Universiti Islam
Selangor (UIS) and Selangor Technical Skills Development Centre (STDC).
records.eligibility_criteria:
Applicant and both parents must be Malaysian citizens.
Must be classified as Orang Asli under the Aboriginal Peoples Act 1954 (Act 134).
Must meet the Selangor birth or residency requirements.
Must be enrolled in a full-time Diploma or Bachelor's Degree programme.
Must not be in the final year of study.
Must not receive any other scholarship, loan or financial assistance.
Good academic performance is preferred.
Official Source: https://danapendidikan.selangor.gov.my/tkwbns/pembiayaan-pendidikan/sagong-tasi-ipt

records.title: Tabung Pendidikan Anak-Anak Syarikat dan Badan Berkanun Negeri Selangor (TPASBB)
records.description:
TPASBB is an education fund established to provide educational assistance to employees of participating
Selangor government-linked companies and statutory bodies and their children.
The fund offers scholarships, academic excellence incentives, tuition assistance and other educational
contributions.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be an employee of an eligible participating company or statutory body, or the child of an
eligible employee.
Must pursue an approved programme.
Must meet the minimum academic requirements.
Must enrol in a recognised institution.
Must comply with the participating agency's funding conditions.
Important: TPASBB is not classified as a general education loan because its published programmes are
mainly scholarships, tuition assistance and educational contributions.
Official Source: https://danapendidikan.selangor.gov.my/tpasbb

records.title: Biasiswa Majlis Agama Islam Wilayah Persekutuan (MAIWP)
records.description:
Biasiswa MAIWP is a scholarship programme for eligible Muslim students from Wilayah Persekutuan
pursuing their first year of undergraduate studies at Malaysian public universities.
The programme supports students from eligible households and covers selected academic disciplines,
including healthcare, Islamic studies, engineering, technology and social sciences.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Must be Muslim.
Must have resided in Wilayah Persekutuan for at least one year.
Must have received an offer for first-year admission in the 2026/2027 academic session at a
Malaysian public university.
Must not receive another scholarship or sponsorship.
Must be in good health.
Must meet MAIWP's additional application requirements.
Approved Fields
Medicine, Dentistry and Pharmacy
Medical Biotechnology and Health Sciences
Islamic Banking and Finance
Law
Science and Technology
Information Technology
Islamic Studies
Engineering
Architecture and Quantity Surveying

records.title: Penang Future Foundation (PFF) Scholarship
records.description:
Penang Future Foundation is a flagship scholarship programme initiated by the Penang State
Government to develop talented Malaysian graduates and strengthen Penang's talent ecosystem.
The programme supports undergraduate students pursuing selected high-demand academic disciplines
at Malaysian public and private universities.
Successful scholars must fulfil a service bond by working in Penang after graduation. The bond duration
depends on the total sponsorship received.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Must be 25 years old or younger.
Must pursue a full-time first Bachelor's Degree.
Must enrol in a programme fully accredited by MQA.
Must have completed STPM, Foundation, Matriculation, Diploma, UEC or equivalent qualifications.
Penang Scholar applicants require a minimum CGPA of 3.67.
Mutiara Scholar applicants require a CGPA between 3.00 and 3.66.
Penang Scholar household income must not exceed RM15,000 monthly.
Mutiara Scholar household income must not exceed RM5,000 monthly.
Eligible disciplines include Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics (STEM), Accountancy
and Finance.
Medicine is excluded.
Must maintain the required academic performance throughout sponsorship.
Funding Details
Item Penang Scholar Mutiara Scholar
Tuition fees Up to RM100,000 Up to RM60,000
Monthly allowance RM800 RM500
Study duration Normal degree duration Normal degree duration
Employment bond Yes Yes
Official Source: https://penangfuturefoundation.my/scholarship-eligibility/

records.title: Penang Future Foundation (PFF) – Mutiara Scholar
records.description:

financially disadvantaged households.
Unlike the Penang Scholar category, Mutiara Scholar has a lower academic entry requirement and a
stricter household income threshold.

throughout the approved study duration.
Recipients must serve an employment bond in Penang after completing their studies.

records.title: Sarawak Free Tertiary Education Scheme (FTES)
records.description:
The Sarawak Free Tertiary Education Scheme (FTES) is a state government initiative introduced in
February 2026 to make higher education more accessible to Sarawakian students.
The scheme covers selected Bachelor's Degree programmes at four designated state-owned higher
education institutions.
The programme focuses on developing skilled graduates in areas such as engineering, science,
technology, medicine, law, accounting and finance.
Eligible students do not need to submit a separate scholarship application. Universities forward the
details of eligible students to the state government for sponsorship processing.
Participating Institutions
Universiti Malaysia Sarawak (UNIMAS).
Swinburne University of Technology Sarawak Campus.
Curtin University Malaysia.
University of Technology Sarawak (UTS).
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Sarawakian.
Must receive admission to one of the four participating institutions.
Must pursue an eligible Bachelor's Degree programme.
Must fulfil the institution's admission requirements.
Must meet the FTES sponsorship conditions.
Programme must be included in the approved list of 64 courses.
Must comply with the university's academic progression requirements.
.
Funding Details
Item Amount
Tuition fees 100%
Living assistance Up to RM15,000/year
Funding duration Approved degree duration
Eligible programmes 64 selected programmes
Separate scholarship application Not required
Application Websites:
https://yayasansarawak.org.my/
https://www.unimas.my/
https://www.swinburne.edu.my/
https://www.curtin.edu.my/
https://www.uts.edu.my/

records.title: Biasiswa Yayasan Sarawak Tun Taib (BYSTT)
records.description:
Biasiswa Yayasan Sarawak Tun Taib is one of the major education sponsorship programmes offered by
Yayasan Sarawak.
The programme supports talented Sarawakian students pursuing higher education in selected academic
disciplines.
Priority is given to STEM and other strategic fields, including Aerospace Engineering, Semiconductor
Technology, Information Technology, Medicine and Health, Life Sciences, Food Technology, Psychology,
Accounting, Finance and Law.
For first Bachelor's Degrees, sponsorship applications are for Malaysian institutions only. Postgraduate
sponsorship applications may cover institutions in Malaysia or overseas.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen and anak jati Sarawak.
At least one parent must be Sarawakian by birth.
Must pursue full-time studies.
Must have received an offer letter from a recognised higher education institution.
Must meet the academic requirements.
Undergraduate applicants must have at least CGPA 3.00 in STPM, Diploma, Matriculation or
Foundation, subject to the applicable entry requirements.
Postgraduate applicants must demonstrate excellent academic results, generally CGPA 3.00 or
above.
Must demonstrate leadership qualities and active participation in extracurricular and community
activities.
Must pass the scholarship selection and interview process.
Applicants currently studying at Certificate, Pre-Diploma, Diploma, Matriculation or Foundation
level are not eligible to apply under the advertised sponsorship category.
Funding Details
Item Funding
Tuition fees Subject to approved full sponsorship
Living allowance Subject to sponsorship agreement
Books and equipment Subject to award
Internship / thesis expenses Subject to award
Return airfare Subject to applicable conditions

records.title: Tunku Abdul Rahman Scholarship (YTAR)
records.description:
The Tunku Abdul Rahman Scholarship is a nationwide scholarship programme supporting deserving
Malaysian students pursuing Bachelor's Degrees at recognised public and private universities.
The scholarship is particularly suitable for students who have overcome difficult circumstances and
demonstrate leadership potential.
Unlike tuition-only scholarships, YTAR provides comprehensive financial support throughout the
scholarship period.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Must enrol in an MQA-accredited Bachelor's Degree programme.
Open to prospective and current undergraduate students.
New undergraduate students must commence their degree by March 2027 under the stated
eligibility conditions.
Current degree students must have at least two years remaining, with graduation after September
2028.
Must demonstrate leadership potential.
Must demonstrate community involvement and commitment to social development.
Priority is given to students from disadvantaged backgrounds, rural communities and households
earning below RM5,250 monthly.
Funding Details
Item Funding
Tuition fees 100%
Monthly living allowance Provided
Annual allowance Provided
Books and stationery Provided
Professional development Provided
Laptop and thesis expenses Eligible allowances
Airfare Limited East–West Malaysia flights
Leadership development 2-year programme
Official Source: YTAR – Tunku Abdul Rahman Scholarship .
Application Portal: https://www.yayasantar.org.my/ytar-tar-scholarship

records.title: Pinjaman Pelajaran Dalam Negara Yayasan Pelajaran Johor (YPJ)
records.description:
Pinjaman Pelajaran Dalam Negara YPJ is an interest-free education loan offered to
eligible Johor students pursuing higher education at approved institutions in
Malaysia.
The loan is intended to help students cover education expenses throughout their
studies.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Must be born and reside in Johor.
Must have received an offer or be currently studying at an eligible institution.
Must pursue full-time studies.
Must have an MQA-accredited programme.
Must have at least one year of study remaining when applying.
Priority is given to students who do not have other sponsorships.
IPTA eligibility includes public universities, UiTM and polytechnics.
IPTS eligibility is limited to selected institutions, including KUYPJ, KKJ and
KUIJSI, depending on study level.
Must fulfil YPJ's other financing conditions.
How to Apply
1. Visit the MyEYPJ portal.
2. Register a new account or log in.
3. Select Pinjaman Pelajaran Dalam Negara.
4. Complete the application form.
5. Upload the required supporting documents.
6. Submit the application within the announced application period.
Official Source: https://www.ypj.gov.my/pages/bantuan/detail/?slug=pinjaman-dalam-negara
Application Portal: https://eypj.ypj.gov.my/applicant/login

records.title: Pinjaman Pendidikan Yayasan Negeri Sembilan (YNS)
records.description:
Pinjaman Pendidikan Yayasan Negeri Sembilan is an education financing initiative by
the Negeri Sembilan State Government through Yayasan Negeri Sembilan.
The programme provides interest-free education loans to eligible Negeri Sembilan
students pursuing higher education at Malaysian public universities and other
approved institutions.
The scheme supports undergraduate and postgraduate students, subject to the
applicable study-level requirements.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Must be born in Negeri Sembilan, OR have either parent born in Negeri
Sembilan, OR have resided in Negeri Sembilan for more than eight years.
Household income must not exceed RM8,400 per month under the current
published requirements.
Must have secured admission to an eligible public higher education institution
(IPTA/UA), polytechnic or approved YNS institution, depending on the study
category.
Must satisfy the full-time or part-time study conditions applicable to the
selected level.
For Diploma and Bachelor's Degree applicants, must apply for PTPTN first.
Applicants rejected by PTPTN must submit the official PTPTN rejection letter.
Must not receive another education loan or scholarship for the same studies
where prohibited.
Must fulfil YNS's academic and documentation requirements.
Additional Information
Diploma and Bachelor's Degree applicants are subject to PTPTN rejection
requirements.
Master's Degree and PhD applicants have separate application conditions.
PhD applications are indicated as open throughout the year.
The loan is paid according to semester arrangements, subject to submission of
examination results.
Repayment is generally requested six months after completion of studies,
according to YNS's FAQ.
Official Source: https://www.yns.gov.my/v7/ms/bahagian/pendidikan/pinjaman
Online Application: https://sp3.yns.gov.my/landing/apply
Application Portal: https://sp3.yns.gov.my/landing
Contact Details:
Telephone: 06-762 8046 / 06-762 8048
Email: spp@yns.gov.my

records.title: Pinjaman Wang Pengajian Tinggi (PWPT) TAPEM
records.description:
Pinjaman Wang Pengajian Tinggi (PWPT) TAPEM is an education loan provided by
the Melaka State Government to assist eligible students from Melaka pursuing higher
education at recognised public and selected private higher education institutions.
The loan is intended to cover education expenses throughout the student's period of
study.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Must qualify as an Anak Negeri Melaka.
Must have received an offer to study at a public or private higher education
institution listed under TAPEM's approved sponsorship institutions.
Must pursue Diploma or Bachelor's Degree studies.
Must fulfil TAPEM's household income and financial assessment.
Must provide two guarantors upon accepting the loan.
Must sign the loan agreement.
Parents who are non-Malaysian citizens are not eligible under the published
conditions.
Definition of Anak Negeri Melaka
The eTAPEM application portal lists the following qualifying categories:
Applicant was born in Melaka; OR
Applicant's mother or father was born in Melaka; OR
Applicant has resided in Melaka for at least ten years.
The main TAPEM eligibility page also specifies residency and voter registration
conditions. Applicants should confirm which combination applies to their
circumstances with TAPEM before submitting.
Funding Amount
The financing depends on household income:
Household gross monthly income Financing
RM6,000 and below 100%
RM6,001–RM10,000 75%
Above RM10,000 50%
Examples of annual financing rates:
Institution / Programme Maximum annual
amount
Public university – Science, Medicine, Engineering Degree RM5,800
Public university – Arts, Professional Studies, Islamic Studies
Degree
RM4,500
Public university – Diploma RM3,500
Polytechnic – Diploma RM3,500
Community College – Diploma RM3,500
Multimedia University – Technology / Engineering Degree RM6,500
Multimedia University – Management / Professional Degree RM5,500
Multimedia University – Diploma RM4,500
Akademi Laut Malaysia – Nautical Studies Diploma RM12,676.66
Amounts are based on TAPEM's published financing schedules and are subject to the
institution and programme eligibility.
Official Sources:
PWPT TAPEM – Eligibility and Application
TAPEM – IPTA Financing Rates
TAPEM – IPTS Financing Rates
Application Method
1. Visit the eTAPEM application portal.
2. Register an account.
3. Select Pinjaman Wang Pengajian Tinggi.
4. Complete the online application.
5. Print the completed application.
6. Attach the required supporting documents.
7. Obtain the necessary document verification.
8. Submit the application to TAPEM before the closing date.
Application Portal: https://tapemonline.melaka.gov.my/
Repayment Conditions
Borrowers must sign a loan agreement with two guarantors.
Repayment begins according to the repayment schedule issued after
completion of studies.
TAPEM issues the repayment schedule six months after the normal study
period ends.
Students who discontinue or are dismissed from their studies may be required
to repay the outstanding loan immediately.
Official Source: https://tapem.melaka.gov.my/pinjaman-wang-pengajian-tinggi

development of lower-income residents in Kuala Lumpur, Putrajaya and Labuan.

repayable education loan. Therefore, it should not be classified as an active
education loan without further confirmation from YWP.

Must provide supporting documents.
Must fulfil the conditions of the specific assistance programme.

records.title: Peduli Siswa – Pinjaman Boleh Ubah Dalam Negara (PBUDN)
records.description:
Peduli Siswa PBUDN is an education financing programme provided by the Selangor
State Government to assist eligible Selangor students pursuing higher education in
Malaysia.
The financing is provided as a convertible education loan, whereby repayment
reductions are determined according to the student's final CGPA, subject to the
programme's conditions.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Applicant, mother or father must be born in Selangor; OR applicant must have
resided in Selangor for more than 10 years.
Applicant, mother and father must be Malaysian citizens.
Must be enrolled in full-time studies.
Must be pursuing Certificate, Diploma, Bachelor's Degree or eligible Medicine
studies.
Must be studying at:
Any recognised public university (IPTA) throughout Malaysia.
Recognised private universities (IPTS) in Selangor or Kuala Lumpur.
Must not be a final-year student or studying under an extension period.
Must not receive another scholarship, education loan or sponsorship for the
same studies.
Household income must not exceed RM20,000 per month.
Must fulfil the academic requirements for the respective study level.
Repayment Reduction
The loan may be reduced according to the final CGPA/PNGK achieved, provided the
student:
Completes studies within the approved period.
Does not breach the financing agreement.
Submits the official academic transcript and Senate certificate.
The exact repayment reduction percentage should be checked against the current
financing agreement.
Official Source: https://danapendidikan.selangor.gov.my/tkwbns/pembiayaan-pendidikan/pbudn
Application Portal: https://edanapendidikan.selangor.gov.my/

records.title: Pinjaman Pelajaran Yayasan Selangor
records.description:
Yayasan Selangor offers education loans to eligible students pursuing full-time
Diploma and Bachelor's Degree programmes at recognised local public universities,
Universiti Selangor (UNISEL) and Universiti Islam Selangor (UIS).
The programme prioritises students from lower-income households and former
students sponsored by Yayasan Selangor.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Applicant, mother and father must be Malaysian citizens.
Applicant, mother or father must be born in Selangor; OR qualify through the
Kuala Lumpur birth condition; OR fulfil the 10-year Selangor residency
condition.
Family per-capita income must not exceed RM3,000 per month.
Must be studying full-time.
Must be pursuing Diploma or Bachelor's Degree.
Must be enrolled at:
Malaysian public higher education institutions (IPTA).
Universiti Selangor (UNISEL).
Universiti Islam Selangor (UIS).
Must not be older than 30 years when applications close.
Must not receive other sponsorship or financial assistance from any local or
international organisation.
Priority is given to former Yayasan Selangor-sponsored students under:
Rancangan Khas Pendidikan Yayasan Selangor (RKPYS).
High Potential Student (HIPERS).
Program Tingkatan Enam Yayasan Selangor (PTEYS).
Application Method
1. Download the Pinjaman Pelajaran application form from Yayasan Selangor's
website.
2. Complete the application form.
3. Prepare the required supporting documents.
4. Submit the completed application to the Bahagian Pembiayaan Pendidikan
Yayasan Selangor before the deadline.
Official Source: https://yayasanselangor.org.my/pinjaman-pelajaran-2/
Application Period: 27 October – 10 November 2026.
Contact Details:
Telephone: 03-7669 1100
Extension: 162 / 188 / 125 / 238
Address: Menara Yayasan Selangor, Petaling Jaya.

records.title: Pinjaman Boleh Ubah Luar Negara (PBULN)
records.description:
PBULN provides education financing to eligible Selangor students pursuing full-time
undergraduate and postgraduate studies at recognised universities in Egypt, Jordan
and Morocco.
The loan can be reduced according to academic performance and completion of
studies within the approved period.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Applicant and both parents must be Malaysian citizens.
Applicant, mother or father must be born and reside in Selangor; OR applicant
must have resided in Selangor for more than 10 years.
Must be enrolled full-time in an eligible university.
Must pursue Bachelor's Degree, Master's Degree or PhD.
University must be recognised in the relevant country.
Must not be in the final semester or an extended study period.
Household income must not exceed RM20,000 per month.
Must not be blacklisted by TKWBNS.
Must fulfil the academic requirements and other financing conditions.
Repayment Reduction
For Middle Eastern PBULN financing, the published repayment reduction conditions
include:
Academic achievement Repayment reduction
Bachelor's – Mumtaz 100%
Bachelor's – Jayyid Jiddan 50%
Bachelor's – Jayyid 25%
Bachelor's – Maqbul 0%
Master's – completed within approved period 100%
PhD – completed within approved period 100%
Official Source: https://danapendidikan.selangor.gov.my/tkwbns/pembiayaan-pendidikan/pbuln
Application Portal: https://edanapendidikan.selangor.gov.my/

records.title: Yayasan Pahang Education Loan (Pinjaman Pendidikan Yayasan Pahang)
records.description:
The Yayasan Pahang Education Loan is a financing programme provided by the
Pahang State Government to assist eligible Pahang students pursuing higher
education at approved Malaysian educational institutions.
The programme supports selected academic and professional fields, as well as
students enrolled at designated institutions under Yayasan Pahang.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Must qualify as an Anak Negeri Pahang.
Must demonstrate good personal character.
Must be in good health.
Must have received an offer or be pursuing studies at an institution approved
by Yayasan Pahang.
Must meet the academic requirements for the relevant study level.
Must fulfil the programme-specific conditions.
Applicants whose parents are non-Malaysian citizens are not eligible.
Funding Amount by Study Level
Study Level / Institution Funding Amount
Master's / PhD – Full-time RM3,000 per year
Master's / PhD – Part-time Tuition fees up to RM10,000 throughout the
study period
Bachelor's Degree – 20 selected public
universities
RM3,000 per year
Polytechnic Diploma RM3,000 per year
SKM / DKM at YPAS Tuition fees and living allowance
Diploma / Degree at UCYP and KYP RM3,000 per year for eligible categories
Studies at UNIQSAAS Depends on study level and scheme
Skills Diploma at Pahang Skills Tuition fees and living allowance
Funding rates are based on Yayasan Pahang's published schedule. Not all study
levels are available at every institution.
Eligible Bachelor's Degree Fields at 20 Selected Public Universities
Pharmacy
Engineering and Technology
Islamic Economics and Finance
Accounting
Teaching English as a Second Language (TESL)
Agriculture and Halal Industry
Tourism and Heritage
Data Science
Artificial Intelligence
Automation and Robotics
E-Commerce
Digital Marketing
Additional Academic Requirements
Master's / PhD: Minimum CGPA of 3.00 or equivalent academic qualification,
subject to the applicable requirements.
Bachelor's Degree: Diploma CGPA of 3.20 or Foundation / Matriculation /
STPM CGPA of 3.00.
MUET: Minimum Band 2 for applicable Bachelor's Degree categories.
Polytechnic Diploma: Applicants must be in their second semester or above.
Repayment Conditions
The loan must be repaid.
Repayment generally begins six months after the sponsorship period ends.
Repayment deferment may be considered for borrowers who continue their
studies, subject to Yayasan Pahang's approval and conditions.
Application Method
1. Visit the official Yayasan Pahang website.
2. Check the latest education loan application announcement.
3. Register and apply through the SYSPIN system.
4. Complete the academic, family and guarantor information.
5. Submit the application before the closing date.
Official Source: Yayasan Pahang Education Loan – Official Information
Application Portal: SYSPIN – Online Application System

records.title: Perak State Higher Education Loan (Pinjaman Pengajian Tinggi Negeri Perak)
records.description:
A state government education financing scheme established to support
eligible Perak students pursuing higher education.
Provides financial assistance to reduce the financial burden of students and
their families.
Students are required to repay the loan according to the applicable
repayment terms.
Eligible Bachelor's Degree loan recipients may qualify for repayment
exemption under the convertible loan scheme.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen.
Must qualify as an eligible Perak student (Anak Perak).
Must be pursuing an eligible higher education programme.
Available for:
Diploma
Bachelor's Degree
Master's Degree
PhD
Must fulfil the specific academic and application requirements set by the
Perak State Government.
Additional eligibility conditions depend on the programme and current
application guidelines.
Special repayment exemption
Bachelor's Degree recipients may be considered for full loan repayment exemption if
they:
Graduate with First Class Honours.
Achieve a CGPA of 3.75 or above, or equivalent.
Submit the exemption application within 12 months of their convocation date.
Contact information:
Email: unitpinjaman@perak.gov.my
Telephone: 05-209 5000
Funding Details
Provided by the Perak State Government.
Managed through the Perak State Higher Education Loan System.
Interest-free financing.
Covers eligible tuition fees, college fees and living expenses.
Available for studies from Diploma to PhD.
Bachelor's Degree studies include local and overseas institutions.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Education Loan (Interest-free)
Additional Information
Application opening information:
1 November 2026
Official Sources:
https://studyfund.perak.gov.my/

records.title: Kedah State Education Financing – SPPNK (iPINJAM)
records.description:
Provides financial assistance to eligible Kedah students pursuing tertiary
education.
Supports students with education-related expenses through annual financing.
The loan amount depends on the level of study and institution.
Available for selected institutions and approved programmes.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen.
Applicant, mother or father must be born in Kedah.
Must have resided in Kedah for at least two years.
Must be a first-year student (Semester 1 or Semester 2) in the current
academic session.
Must pursue full-time studies.
Must enrol in an eligible Certificate, Diploma or first Bachelor's Degree
programme.
Applicant and parents/guardians must not be blacklisted by SPPNK.
Must not receive other financial sponsorship or assistance for the same
studies.
Funding Details
Provided by the Kedah State Government through the State Education
Financing Section (SPPNK).
Available for full-time studies at selected local public and private higher
education institutions.
Covers first-time Certificate, Diploma and Bachelor's Degree programmes.
Repayment begins 12 months after completion of studies.
Students and their guarantors are responsible for repayment.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Education Loan
Additional Information
Application opening information:
11 August 2026
Official Sources:
https://sppnk.kedah.gov.my/ipinjam

records.title: Yayasan Islam Negeri Kedah (YINK) – Education Loan
records.description:
Provides financial support to eligible Kedah students pursuing higher
education, particularly in Islamic studies and selected professional
programmes.
Supports students studying medicine and accounting, among other
specifically advertised programmes.
Applicants may be required to attend an interview.
Loan approval and funding amounts are subject to YINK's conditions.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Muslim.
Must qualify as a Kedah-born student (Anak Negeri Kedah).
Applicant or either parent must be born in Kedah.
Applicants born outside Kedah may qualify if they or their parents have
resided in Kedah for more than 10 years, with official residency confirmation.
Must not receive sponsorship from another organisation.
Must fulfil the academic requirements for the selected programme.
Must submit the required supporting documents.
Funding Details
Provided by Yayasan Islam Negeri Kedah (YINK).
Offers education loans for selected programmes and institutions.
Includes selected programmes at UniSHAMS and universities in Egypt and
Jordan.
Funding is subject to programme approval and YINK's current application
announcement.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Education Loan
Additional Information
Application opening information:
Announced periodically by YINK.
Official Sources:
https://yink.gov.my

records.title: Penang State Student Loan (Pinjaman Penuntut Negeri Pulau Pinang – ePPN)
records.description:
Established in 1970 to provide higher education financing for eligible
Malaysian students with connections to Penang.
Provides annual financial support according to the student's qualification level
and field of study.
Covers Certificate, Diploma, Advanced Diploma, Bachelor's Degree, Master's
Degree and PhD programmes.
Students who graduate with First Class Honours may apply to convert their
loan into a scholarship, subject to approval.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Must be born in Penang OR have attended school in Penang for at least 5
years.
Must have received an offer from a local university or higher education
institution.
Private institution applicants must enrol in an MQA-approved programme.
Must be enrolled in an eligible programme lasting at least one year.
Students receiving sponsorship from other organisations, including PTPTN,
MARA or JPA, are not eligible.
Students currently pursuing Pre-University, Matriculation, KPLI, Skills
Certificate or Vocational College programmes are not eligible.
Funding Details
Provided by the Penang State Government.
Managed by the Penang State Student Loan and Scholarship Board.
Available for local public and private higher education institutions.
Private institution programmes must be approved by the Malaysian
Qualifications Agency (MQA).
Loan repayment period: 5 years.
Interest rate: 1% of the total loan amount.
Second-time applications are permitted only after the first loan has been fully
repaid.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Education Loan
Additional Information
Application opening information:
1 July 2026
Official Sources:
https://eppn.penang.gov.my

records.title: Perlis State Education Loan (Pinjaman Pelajaran Negeri Perlis)
records.description:
Provides financial assistance to eligible Perlis students pursuing higher
education.
Supports students undertaking undergraduate and postgraduate studies.
Intended to help students finance their tertiary education.
First Class Honours graduates may qualify for a 50% repayment discount,
according to the historical state budget announcement.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen.
Applicant, father or mother must be a native of Perlis.
Must be of Malay descent.
Must have resided in Perlis continuously for at least five years.
Must have received education in Perlis during the relevant residency period.
Must pursue full-time studies.
Must be enrolled in an eligible Bachelor's Degree, Master's Degree or PhD
programme.
Local and overseas university studies are covered under the published
application conditions.
Funding Details
Originally provided through the Perlis State Government's Education Loan
Trust Fund.
Administration of education loans was transferred to Yayasan Islam Perlis
(YIPs) from 1 July 2024.
Available for full-time studies.
Covers eligible local and overseas universities.
The 2020 state budget speech announced RM10,000 per year for Master's and
PhD studies.
Current approved amounts and repayment terms should be confirmed with
YIPs.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Education Loan
Additional Information
Application opening information:
No fixed annual opening date published.
Official Sources:
1. https://yips.gov.my
2.
https://www.perlis.gov.my/images/pekeliling/BORANG_PERMOHONAN_PINJAMAN_MELAYU.pdf

records.title: Perlis Education Loan Advance (Pendahuluan Pinjaman Pelajaran)
records.description:
Provides temporary financial assistance to students before receiving their
main education loan or scholarship.
Helps cover initial university expenses.
The RM2,000 advance must be repaid once the student receives another loan
or scholarship.
If no other funding is obtained, repayment is required before or after one
semester or academic session, whichever comes first.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen.
Applicant, father or mother must be from Perlis.
Must be of Malay descent.
Must have lived in Perlis continuously for at least five years.
Must have received education in Perlis during that period.
Must be pursuing full-time Bachelor's Degree studies.
Must be enrolled in a local university.
Funding Details
Provided through the Perlis State Scholarship Fund.
Available for students entering local universities.
Limited to one application throughout the study period.
Must be repaid according to the loan agreement.

records.title: Yayasan Kelantan Darulnaim (YAKIN) – Education Loan (Pinjaman Pelajaran)
records.description:
Provides financial support to eligible students from Kelantan pursuing higher
education.
Helps students finance tuition and other education-related expenses.
Supports academic programmes in general higher education, Islamic studies
and selected professional fields.
Students are required to repay the loan according to YAKIN's repayment
terms.
Death-benefit contributions (Khairat Kematian) apply according to the annual
loan amount.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen of Kelantan descent.
Must be a resident of Kelantan.
Must have received an admission offer from an eligible public higher
education institution (IPTA).
Must have obtained a credit in Bahasa Melayu at SPM level.
Must not be older than 25 years on the application closing date.
Students in Year 2, 3 or 4 must have a minimum CGPA of 2.50 or equivalent.
Applicants must not be receiving financial sponsorship from another
organisation.
Funding Details
Provided by Yayasan Kelantan Darulnaim (YAKIN).
Available for eligible local and overseas higher education institutions
recognised by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA).
Covers Diploma and Bachelor's Degree programmes.
Loan amounts vary according to the programme, institution and country of
study.
Applicants may apply online through the YAKIN Education Loan Management
System.
Second-time applications are considered only after the previous loan has been
settled or the previous studies completed.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Education Loan
Additional Information
Application opening information:
Domestic studies – June every year.
Overseas studies – August every year.
Official Sources:
1. https://yakin.kelantan.gov.my/index.php?catid=9&id=60&view=article
2.  https://yakin.kelantan.gov.my/index.php?id=89&view=article

records.title: Yayasan Sabah – Higher Education Loan (Pinjaman Pengajian Tinggi Yayasan Sabah)
records.description:
Provides financial assistance to eligible Sabah students pursuing higher
education.
Supports undergraduate and postgraduate studies.
Offers different financing categories depending on the institution, country and
mode of study.
Students are required to repay the loan according to Yayasan Sabah's
repayment terms.
Certain eligible graduates may qualify for repayment rebates based on
academic achievement.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Applicant must be a Malaysian citizen.
Applicant, mother and father must meet one of the following conditions:
Applicant and both parents are Malaysian citizens originating from
Sabah; OR
Applicant and both parents are Malaysian citizens, with at least one
parent originating from Sabah; OR
Applicant or parent must have Sabah Permanent Resident (PR) status,
subject to the stated conditions.
Priority is given to applicants who originate from and reside in Sabah.
Must meet the relevant age requirements:
Certificate / Diploma / Bachelor's Degree – Not older than 35 years.
Master's Degree / PhD – Not older than 45 years.
Must enrol in an eligible programme and institution.
Must submit the required supporting documents, including identification,
birth certificates, academic results and admission letter (if available).
Funding Details
Provided by Kumpulan Yayasan Sabah.
Applications are managed through the Portal Tajaan Pendidikan Sabah (PTPS).
Available for local and overseas studies, subject to the applicable loan
category.
Loan categories include:
Local higher education loan.
University College Sabah Foundation (UCSF) loan.
ASEAN / Middle East education loan.
Distance Learning (PJJ) loan.
Overseas education loan.
Age limits:
Certificate, Diploma and Bachelor's Degree – Maximum 35 years old.
Master's Degree and PhD – Maximum 45 years old.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Education Loan
Additional Information
Application opening information:
2026 application announcement published in April 2026.
Official Sources:
1. https://ptps.sabah.gov.my
2. https://www.yayasansabahgroup.org.my

records.title: Yayasan Sarawak – Domestic Education Loan (Skim Biasiswa Pinjaman Pelajaran Dalam Negara)
records.description:
Provides financial support to Sarawakian students pursuing tertiary education
in Malaysia.
Helps cover education-related expenses.
Supports eligible undergraduate and postgraduate studies, subject to the
specific loan category.
Loan approval and amount depend on Yayasan Sarawak's assessment.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen.
At least one parent must be Sarawakian.
Must be pursuing full-time studies.
Must not receive another sponsorship for the same studies.
Must obtain a credit in Bahasa Melayu:
SPM – Grade C or above.
GCE O-Level – Grade C or above.
UEC – Grade B6 or above.
Age requirements:
Bachelor's Degree – Maximum 45 years old.
Master's Degree and PhD – Maximum 50 years old.
Must provide two guarantors with permanent employment, generally below
60 years old.
Must fulfil the additional requirements of the selected institution and Yayasan
Sarawak.
Funding Details
Provided by Yayasan Sarawak.
Available for eligible Sarawakian students studying at local higher education
institutions.
Covers eligible full-time programmes.
Applications are submitted through the Yayasan Sarawak online portal.
Repayment begins 12 months after graduation.
Two guarantors with permanent employment may be required.
Certain institutional arrangements may include top-up financing.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Education Loan
Additional Information
Application opening information:
Applications are generally accepted throughout the year,
subject to the scheme and institution.

arrangement.

Must satisfy the applicable application and financial conditions.
Funding Details

records.description:
Government financial assistance provided by the Ministry of Education
Malaysia (MOE).
Designed to support students from low-income households pursuing long-
term Certificate programmes at Community Colleges.
Available through Community Colleges nationwide.
records.eligibility_criteria:

Helps cover students' living and educational expenses.

records.title: Foundation Financial Assistance for Public Universities (BKA UA)
records.description:
Government financial assistance provided by MOHE.
Supports B40 and M40 students pursuing Foundation programmes at selected
public universities.
Aims to reduce the financial burden of entering higher education.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen.
Household income below RM10,000.
Belongs to the B40 or M40 income group.
Enrolled in an approved Foundation programme at a participating public
university.
Must have entered the programme using SPM or equivalent qualifications.
Must not receive another scholarship or sponsorship.
Participating Universities:
Universiti Malaya (UM)
Universiti Utara Malaysia (UUM)
Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM)
Universiti Teknologi MARA (UiTM)
Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS)
Universiti Sains Islam Malaysia (USIM)
Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia (UKM)
Universiti Malaysia Sarawak (UNIMAS)
Universiti Sultan Zainal Abidin (UniSZA)
International Islamic University Malaysia (IIUM)
Universiti Pertahanan Nasional Malaysia (UPNM)
Funding Details
RM2,500 annual living allowance.
RM1,420 annual tuition and accommodation assistance.
Available for eligible Foundation students.
Students must repay the assistance if they fail to complete their studies
successfully.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Non-repayable Financial Assistance (subject to programme conditions).
Official Sources:
https://www.moe.gov.my/bantuan-kewangan-asasi

records.title: Living Allowance Assistance for Negeri Sembilan Students (Bantuan Sara Hidup Mahasiswa Anak Negeri Sembilan)
records.description:
Financial assistance initiative by the Negeri Sembilan State Government and
Yayasan Negeri Sembilan (YNS).
Designed to support students from low-income families pursuing higher
education.
Helps reduce the financial burden of university and polytechnic students.
Focuses on students from Negeri Sembilan who require ongoing financial
support.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen.
Must be born in Negeri Sembilan and currently reside in Negeri Sembilan.
OR
Not born in Negeri Sembilan but must have attended school in Negeri
Sembilan for at least six years.
Currently pursuing a full-time Diploma or Bachelor's Degree.
Must be enrolled at a public university or public polytechnic.
Eligible from Semester 1 until the final semester.
Either parent must be a recipient of Sumbangan Tunai Rahmah (STR) 2026.
Parents' or guardians' household income must not exceed RM5,000 per
month.
Must submit the required study verification documents.
Non-Negeri Sembilan-born applicants must provide the required residency /
schooling verification documents.
Participating Institutions:
Public universities (IPTA / UA) in Malaysia.
Public polytechnics in Malaysia.
Funding Details
Provides RM200 monthly living allowance to eligible students.
Assistance is available throughout the approved study period.
Supports students with daily living and educational expenses.
Applications are managed by Yayasan Negeri Sembilan.
Requires annual application / verification according to the programme
requirements.
Not an education loan or academic scholarship.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Non-repayable Financial Assistance (Recurring – Monthly).
Official Sources:
https://www.yns.gov.my/v7/ms/bahagian/pendidikan/pembangunan-insan/bantuan-sara-hidup

records.title: Monthly Living Allowance Assistance for IPT Students (Bantuan Sara Anak IPT)
records.description:
Zakat-funded financial assistance administered by Majlis Agama Islam Melaka
(MAIM).
Supports the living expenses of eligible asnaf students pursuing higher
education.
Intended to provide ongoing financial support throughout the approved
assistance period.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must qualify under Asnaf Fakir, Miskin or Muallaf categories.
Must meet MAIM's zakat eligibility and assessment requirements.
Must be currently enrolled in an IPT.
Must provide official student verification documents.
Must undergo MAIM's eligibility assessment.
Specific residency requirements should be confirmed with MAIM.
Participating Institutions:
Institutions of higher education (IPT).
The official scheme does not publish a specific list of participating institutions.
Funding Details
Provides monthly financial assistance to eligible IPT students.
Covers students categorised as Asnaf Fakir, Miskin and Muallaf.
Applicants must submit proof of student status from their IPT.
Existing MAIM monthly assistance recipients can request the addition of IPT
student support.
Assistance is subject to MAIM approval.
No fixed payment amount is published on the official scheme page.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Non-repayable Financial Assistance (Recurring – Monthly).
Zakat Assistance.

records.title: Monthly Financial Assistance Scheme (Skim Bantuan Kewangan Bulanan)
records.description:
Financial assistance administered by Majlis Agama Islam Wilayah Persekutuan
(MAIWP).
Supports eligible asnaf individuals who face financial difficulties.
Intended to help recipients meet their essential living expenses.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Muslim.
Malaysian citizen.
Must have resided in the Federal Territories for at least one year and still be
residing there.
Must meet the applicable Had Kifayah requirements.
Must qualify under the relevant asnaf category.

Provides monthly financial support to eligible individuals.

assessment.
Assistance is not required to be repaid.
Students may apply for more than one type of assistance, subject to eligibility.
IPT student eligibility under this general monthly scheme must be confirmed
with MAIWP.

Zakat Assistance.

records.title: Student Monthly Living Allowance Assistance (Bantuan Wang Saku Zakat Selangor)
records.description:
Financial assistance provided by Lembaga Zakat Selangor (LZS).
Helps eligible asnaf students manage their daily living expenses while
pursuing higher education.
Designed to support students who have already received LZS higher
education sponsorship.
Provides additional financial support alongside approved education
assistance.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen.
Registered as Asnaf Fakir, Miskin or Mualaf with Zakat Selangor.
Must have received approval for Bantuan Dermasiswa Pengajian Tinggi
(BDPT).
Must have completed the BDPT sponsorship acceptance process.
Must meet LZS's applicable assistance requirements.
Must submit a new application for each semester or study level.
Subject to LZS assessment and approval.
Participating Institutions:
Public Universities (IPTA).
Public Skills Training Institutions (ILKA).
Approved private higher education institutions and educational partners
under LZS collaboration arrangements.
Funding Details
Provides RM400 monthly living allowance.
Payment is made in a lump sum for each approved semester.
Students must submit a new application at the beginning of every semester or
study level.
Available to existing students who have received approval under Bantuan
Dermasiswa Pengajian Tinggi (BDPT).
Application and payment are subject to LZS approval.
Not an education loan.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Non-repayable Financial Assistance (Recurring – Monthly).
Zakat Assistance.
Official Sources:
https://www.zakatselangor.com.my/pendidikan/

records.title: Monthly Living Allowance for Asnaf Higher Education Students (Bantuan Sara Hidup Bulanan Pelajar IPT)
records.description:
Financial assistance administered by Majlis Ugama Islam dan Adat Resam
Melayu Pahang (MUIP).
Supports students from asnaf families pursuing higher education.
Helps cover monthly living expenses and other essential study-related costs.
Available to eligible Pahang students studying within or outside the state.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be Muslim.
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Must be a Pahang resident or meet MUIP's residency requirements.
Must qualify under the applicable asnaf categories, particularly Fakir or Miskin.
Must be currently enrolled in an IPT.
Must demonstrate financial need.
Subject to MUIP's Had Kifayah assessment and approval.
Must provide supporting documents, including proof of enrolment and
household income.
Participating Institutions:
Public Universities (IPTA / UA).
Private Higher Education Institutions (IPTS).
Other recognised higher education institutions, subject to MUIP approval.
Students studying outside Pahang may also be considered.
Funding Details
Provides monthly financial assistance of up to RM500.
Amount is assessed according to the student's financial needs.
Assessment considers the student's study location and living costs.
Assistance can be continued for as long as the student requires it, subject to
MUIP approval.
Additional assistance may be considered for specific final-year academic
expenses, including project costs.
Not an education loan or scholarship.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Non-repayable Financial Assistance (Recurring – Monthly).
Zakat Assistance.
Official Sources:
https://muip.gov.my/zakat/skim-bantuan-zakat

records.title: Higher Education Financial Assistance Scheme (Skim Dermasiswa Pengajian Zakat MAINPP)
records.description:
Zakat-funded education assistance administered by Majlis Agama Islam
Negeri Pulau Pinang (MAINPP).
Supports eligible Muslim students from financially disadvantaged
backgrounds.
Helps students continue their higher education.
Available for various academic fields that benefit religion and society.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen.
Muslim.
Must have resided permanently in Pulau Pinang for at least 12 months at the
time of application.
Must be enrolled in a recognised higher education institution.
Must achieve a minimum cumulative CGPA of 2.75, except for students
studying overseas.
Parents who are eligible to pay zakat must fulfil MAINPP's zakat payment
requirements.
Students residing outside Pulau Pinang are generally ineligible unless their
parents pay at least RM1,200 in annual zakat property to MAINPP.
Must not receive other sponsorships, scholarships or convertible loans, except
the specifically permitted funding listed by MAINPP.
Participating Institutions:
Recognised public universities (IPTA).
Recognised private universities (IPTS).
Recognised institutions in Malaysia and overseas.
Funding Details
Provides financial assistance to students pursuing higher education.
Covers Diploma, Bachelor's Degree, Master's Degree and PhD programmes.
Available for studies within and outside Malaysia.
Supports students studying in MQA-recognised institutions.
Students must submit their latest academic results and proof of enrolment.
Applicants must meet MAINPP's zakat and financial eligibility requirements.

records.title: Sultan Ismail Petra Education Financial Assistance (Dermasiswa Sultan Ismail Petra – DSIP MAIK)
records.description:
Zakat-funded education assistance administered by Majlis Agama Islam dan
Adat Istiadat Melayu Kelantan (MAIK).
Helps eligible asnaf students continue their higher education.
Supports students studying in Malaysia and overseas.
Covers various beneficial academic disciplines.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen.
Must be born in Kelantan and permanently reside in Kelantan.
Parents or guardians must also reside in Kelantan.
Must qualify under MAIK's eligible asnaf categories.
Gross household income must not exceed RM10,000 per month.
Must not receive other sponsorships, scholarships or convertible loans, except
the specifically permitted PTPTN and Kelantan state assistance.
Domestic applicants must achieve a minimum CGPA of 3.00 or equivalent 75%
passing result.
Domestic applicants must have completed at least Semester 2 or be in their
second academic year onwards.
Subject to MAIK approval.
Participating Institutions:
Recognised domestic higher education institutions.
Recognised overseas higher education institutions, subject to programme
conditions.
Funding Details
Provides financial assistance to eligible Kelantan students pursuing higher
education.
Students may apply once per year throughout their study period.
Maximum one approval per year.
Not paid every semester.
Students must meet the academic requirements for continuation.
Funded through MAIK zakat allocation.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Non-repayable Financial Assistance (Recurring – Annually).
Zakat Assistance.
Official Sources:
https://eagihan.e-maik.my/

records.title: Financial Assistance for Persons with Disabilities (BKOKU)
records.description:
Financial assistance provided by the Ministry of Higher Education (MOHE).
Supports students with disabilities pursuing higher education.
Available at public universities, eligible private universities, Polytechnics and
Community Colleges.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizens.
Registered with the Department of Social Welfare (JKM).
Must possess a valid OKU card.
Enrolled in an MQA-recognised programme.
Currently studying at an eligible Malaysian higher education institution.
Students receiving education loans or self-funding are eligible.
Students receiving another scholarship are generally not eligible.
Funding Details
RM3,100 for every six-month semester.
Covers tuition fees, accommodation fees and pocket money.
Available for full-time, part-time and distance-learning students.
Not based on household income.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Financial Assistance / Education Allowance.
Official Sources:
https://bkoku.mohe.gov.my

Financial assistance specifically for registered students with disabilities.
Covers living allowances and tuition fees, depending on study mode
and eligibility.
Does not require applicants to meet a household income threshold.

Supports students with disabilities pursuing higher education.
Helps reduce financial barriers to continuing tertiary education.

Must be registered with JKM and possess a valid OKU card.
Must be enrolled in an eligible public or recognised private higher
education institution, polytechnic or community college.
Must pursue an MQA- or JPA-recognised course.
Eligible study levels include Diploma, Bachelor's Degree, Master's
Degree and PhD.
Must not be on paid study leave.
Additional restrictions apply to students receiving disability-specific
scholarships.

Supports students from economically disadvantaged households.
Specifically covers eligible full-time Diploma and Bachelor's Degree students
at public universities (IPTA).
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizens.
Listed in the eKasih database.
Enrolled in a full-time Diploma or Bachelor's Degree programme.
Studying at a public university (IPTA).
Must satisfy the applicable PTPTN requirements.

Provides free higher education financing for eligible students.
PTPTN financing is provided in the form of a scholarship.
Targets students from poor and hardcore-poor households.
Intended to reduce the financial burden of pursuing higher education.

records.title: JAKOA Higher Education Financial Assistance (Bantuan Kewangan Pendidikan IPT)
records.description:
Financial assistance provided by the Department of Orang Asli Development
(JAKOA).
Supports Orang Asli students pursuing higher education.
Available for studies at public and private higher education institutions
throughout Malaysia.
Helps improve access to higher education for the Orang Asli community.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizens.
Must be recognised as Orang Asli under the Aboriginal Peoples Act 1954 (Act
134).
Must not be older than 35 years.
Must be enrolled or planning to enrol in a Malaysian higher education
institution.
Students receiving government or private scholarships, bursaries or education
loans are not eligible under the published application conditions.
Must provide the required academic, financial and supporting documents.
Funding Details
Financial assistance for eligible Orang Asli students.
Supports students entering or currently studying at Malaysian IPT.
Funding is awarded according to the suitability of the course.
Not available to students already receiving another government or private
scholarship, bursary or education loan under the published application
conditions.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Education Financial Assistance / Educational Sponsorship.
Official Sources:
https://idamak.jakoa.gov.my/permohonan

records.title: Higher Education Admission Assistance (Skim Bantuan Kemasukan ke Institusi Pengajian Tinggi – IPT)
records.description:
Financial assistance provided by the Department of Veterans Affairs (JHEV
ATM).
Intended to reduce the financial burden of children of Malaysian Armed
Forces veterans entering higher education.
Encourages children of veterans to pursue higher education.
Available to eligible veteran families throughout Malaysia.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Children of eligible Malaysian Armed Forces (ATM) veterans.
The veteran must not have been dishonourably discharged due to disciplinary
offences.
The applicant must not exceed 23 years old at the time of IPT registration or
admission.
Must be enrolled in a full-time Diploma or First Degree programme.
The programme must be offered by a Malaysian public or private higher
education institution.
The programme must be recognised by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency
(MQA).
Each child is eligible for one assistance payment only, either at Diploma or
Bachelor's Degree level.
Funding Details
One-off financial assistance for higher education registration expenses.
No repayment required.
Available for studies at public and private higher education institutions.
Covers recognised full-time Diploma and First Degree programmes.
Each eligible child can receive the assistance once, either at Diploma or
Bachelor's Degree level.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Special Financial Assistance / One-Off Cash Grant.
Official Sources:
https://jhev.gov.my/bantuan-untuk-veteran-atm/meringankan-beban-kewangan

records.title: Skim Bantuan Am Pelajaran IPT
records.description:
Zakat-based educational assistance for financially disadvantaged
students.
Helps eligible students continue their higher education.
Targets Fakir, Miskin, Muallaf and Fisabilillah categories.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Muslim Malaysian citizen.
Must have resided in Kuala Lumpur, Putrajaya or Labuan for at least
one year and still reside there.
Must qualify under MAIWP's Had Kifayah assessment.
Must be enrolled in a recognised higher education institution.
Study duration must be at least six months.
Must not receive a full scholarship or full sponsorship.
Full-time and part-time students may apply.
Funding Details
Financial assistance for students from eligible Asnaf categories.
Supports students pursuing higher education at recognised institutions.
Assistance amount is determined based on individual financial
circumstances and Had Kifayah assessment.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
One-off financial assistance.

https://www.maiwp.gov.my/portal-main/bantuan-zakat

records.title: Bantuan Kecemasan (Emergency Assistance)
records.description:
Special emergency assistance for individuals and families experiencing
unexpected financial hardship.
Potentially relevant to IPT students whose family breadwinner has died,
lost employment or experienced an unexpected financial crisis.
Also relevant when students have suddenly lost their source of financial
support.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must generally qualify under one of the following Asnaf categories:
Fakir
Miskin
Muallaf
Al-Gharimin
Ar-Riqab
Ibn Sabil
Fisabilillah
Must demonstrate an urgent financial need.
Must generally fulfil MAIWP's Federal Territory residency requirements.
Applicants who have lost their living expenses or are experiencing
exceptional hardship may be considered.
Subject to MAIWP's assessment and approval.
Funding Details
Emergency financial support for eligible Asnaf facing sudden financial
difficulties.
Helps individuals whose essential living expenses have been disrupted.
Payment is made directly to the approved recipient.
Exceptional cases may be considered even if certain general eligibility
conditions are not met.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
One-off financial assistance.
Official Sources:
https://www.maiwp.gov.my/portal-main/usahawan-zakat-maiwp

records.title: Bantuan Perubatan Am (General Medical Assistance)
records.description:
Special medical assistance for financially disadvantaged individuals
experiencing health-related difficulties.
Relevant to IPT students suffering from chronic or critical illnesses.
May also benefit students whose parents or dependants require
expensive medical treatment.
Helps reduce the financial burden associated with healthcare expenses.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must generally qualify under MAIWP's eligible Asnaf categories.
Muslim Malaysian citizen.
Must generally have resided in the Federal Territories for at least one
year and continue residing there.
Must meet MAIWP's Had Kifayah financial assessment.
Must demonstrate a genuine medical or healthcare-related financial
need.
Must provide supporting medical documentation, such as:
Medical reports.
Doctor's recommendations.
Prescriptions.
Hospital treatment or medication quotations.
Subject to MAIWP's approval.
Funding Details
Financial assistance for eligible individuals requiring medical treatment.
Helps cover medical expenses that applicants cannot afford.
May cover eligible treatment, medication and medical-related
expenses.
Requires medical reports, prescriptions or official cost estimates.
Assistance is subject to MAIWP's assessment and approval.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
One-off financial assistance.
Official Sources:
https://www.maiwp.gov.my/portal-main/bantuan-zakat

records.title: Bantuan Dermasiswa Pengajian Tinggi (BDPT) 2026
records.description:
Higher education sponsorship provided by Lembaga Zakat Selangor (LZS).
Designed to help eligible asnaf students continue their full-time studies
without financial difficulties.
Specifically targets students from the Fakir, Miskin and Mualaf categories.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be registered as an asnaf Fakir, Miskin or Mualaf with Zakat Selangor.
Must have received an admission offer from a recognised IPTA, ILKA or LZS
collaborative institution.
Must pursue full-time studies.
Must fulfil the specific requirements established by Zakat Selangor.
Applicants must be registered with Zakat Selangor when applying.
Funding Details
Supports students throughout their basic study period.
Covers approved tuition fees.
Provides an initial university preparation allowance.
Uses a dual-financing approach for the 2026 intake.
Students may obtain additional educational support through recognised
funding agencies such as PTPTN, MARA or PTPK.
Students must fulfil the relevant application and sponsorship requirements.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Financial Assistance
Official Sources:
Official information: https://www.zakatselangor.com.my/pendidikan/

records.description:

Helps students manage financial difficulties and continue their studies.
Particularly relevant to students experiencing unexpected financial hardship.

Must demonstrate financial need.

Assistance is available through the UNISEL Islamic Centre's Zakat and Sadaqah

eligible students.
Assistance may be provided even to students who already receive other
sponsorships.
Funding is subject to availability and institutional assessment.

One-off / Financial Assistance

records.title: Dermasiswa Pelajar Miskin IPT – Yayasan Pahang
records.description:
Special educational assistance for financially disadvantaged students
from Pahang.
Particularly relevant to students from poor families, single-parent
households and families with disabled or chronically ill parents.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must qualify as a Pahang native.
Must be studying full-time at a government-recognised institution.
Parents or guardians must be poor and financially disadvantaged.
Family should have several dependent children attending school.
Monthly parental income must not exceed RM700, with at least three
school-going dependants under the published criteria.
Priority is given to recipients of Social Welfare Department assistance,
children of single mothers, and families with disabled or elderly
guardians.
Must not receive another scholarship.
Funding Details
Financial support for students from extremely poor households.
Supports full-time studies at recognised higher education institutions.
Priority is given to families facing severe financial hardship.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Education Bursary / Financial Assistance (Non-repayable,
subject to approval).
Official Sources:
https://www.yp.org.my/program-bantuan-pendidikan/derwasiswa-pelajar-miskin-ipt/

losses.

records.title: Tabung Serambi Mekah (Kelantan State Government Emergency Assistance Fund)
records.description:
Helps individuals and families experiencing sudden financial hardship.
Particularly relevant to IPT students whose families experience house fires,
storms or serious medical emergencies.
Students may apply if they meet the assistance requirements; the scheme is
not exclusively for students.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Kelantan resident.
Must be affected by a qualifying disaster or chronic illness.
Must obtain verification from the Assistant District Officer (Ketua Penolong
Ketua Jajahan).
Supporting documents:
Police report for fire or storm incidents.
Medical report for chronic illness.
Photographs of the disaster.
Completed application form with the required verification.
Funding Details
Established by the Kelantan State Government.
Provides emergency financial assistance to people affected by disasters and
chronic illnesses.
Assistance is subject to assessment and approval.
Processing takes approximately two weeks after submission.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
One-off emergency financial assistance.
Non-repayable contribution.
Official Sources:
Official information: https://ppn.kelantan.gov.my/index.php/hubungi-kami/about?catid=8&id=51:soalan-lazim-tabung-serambi-mekah&view=article

records.title: MAIDAM Medical Assistance (Bantuan Perubatan / Hemodialisis)
records.description:
Helps reduce the financial burden of serious illnesses and medical treatment.
Relevant to students or families facing significant medical expenses.
Can be particularly helpful when a parent's illness affects the household's
financial stability.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must satisfy MAIDAM's residency and zakat requirements.
Must demonstrate genuine medical and financial needs.
Must provide supporting medical reports.
Treatment and assistance must meet MAIDAM's approved conditions.
Funding Details
Supports eligible individuals requiring medical treatment.
Includes general medical assistance and haemodialysis support.
MAIDAM also administers assistance for certain chronic medical conditions.
Medical documents and treatment cost evidence may be required.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Zakat-based medical assistance.
Non-repayable financial support.
Official Sources:
Official website: https://www.maidam.terengganu.gov.my/

records.title: Special Financial Assistance for Sarawak Students (Bantuan Khas Kewangan Sarawak)
records.description:
A state-government financial assistance programme for Sarawakian IPT
students.
Supports students regardless of whether they study within or outside
Sarawak.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen with at least one Sarawakian parent or guardian.
Currently enrolled in a Diploma or Bachelor's Degree programme.
Studying full-time at an MOHE-recognised IPTA or IPTS.
Must obtain institutional verification.
Not specifically restricted to B40 students.
Funding Details
Provides financial assistance to Sarawakian students studying at
recognised higher education institutions throughout Malaysia.
Intended to help cover food, daily necessities and essential living
expenses.
The Sarawak Government allocated RM60 million for the programme in
2026.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Non-repayable financial assistance (annual student living-expense
support).
Official Sources:
https://myys.yayasansarawak.org.my/

records.title: Emergency Assistance for Natural Disasters and Public Health Emergencies (Bantuan Kecemasan – Bencana Alam dan Kesihatan Awam)
records.description:
Emergency financial support for households experiencing sudden
financial hardship due to natural disasters or public health
emergencies.
Relevant to Sarawakian IPT students whose families are directly affected
by these incidents.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Muslim resident of Sarawak or a Malaysian citizen residing in
Sarawak.
Must be directly affected by a qualifying disaster or public health
emergency.
Must provide official verification from relevant authorities, such as:
Police Department.
Fire and Rescue Department.
Social Welfare Department.
Sarawak State Disaster Management Committee.
Applications are subject to investigation and approval.
Funding Details
Provides financial support to individuals and families affected by
disasters.
Covers incidents such as:
Floods.
House fires.
Landslides.
Storms.
Critical infectious disease outbreaks.
Severe haze-related public health emergencies.
Assistance is generally provided once, although repeat assistance may
be considered for certain cases following further investigation.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Non-repayable emergency financial assistance.
Official Sources:
https://www.tbs.org.my/www/?page=154

import_metadata.amount_note:

records.title: Bantuan Khas Pembelian Tiket Penerbangan Secara Sekali Beri (One-Off) – FlySiswa 2026
records.description:
Government financial assistance to reduce the cost of domestic air travel for
new public higher education students.
Helps students who need to travel across regions to begin their studies.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizens.
New students enrolling in 2026.
Must have accepted an offer through UPUOnline to a public university
(Universiti Awam) or a Premier Polytechnic.
Must enrol in September or October 2026.
Must undertake domestic air travel across Peninsular Malaysia, Sabah, Sarawak
or Labuan for study registration.
Must fulfil the programme's application requirements.
Funding Details
RM500 assistance for eligible domestic flight tickets.
Supports travel between Peninsular Malaysia, Sabah, Sarawak and Labuan.
Intended to help students travel to their respective institutions for registration.
Each eligible student receives the assistance once.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
One-off flight ticket financial assistance (non-repayable).
Official Sources:
https://bantuansiswa.mot.gov.my/

records.title: Tabung Pendidikan Sarjana PDT (TPSPDT)
records.description:
A corporate social responsibility initiative supporting financially disadvantaged
Johor students pursuing postgraduate education.
Helps reduce the financial burden of postgraduate studies.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be born in Johor or have resided in Johor for at least five years.
Must be currently pursuing a Master's Degree.
Must be enrolled at a public university or an eligible Johor state government
university.
Working applicants must have a household income not exceeding RM4,850
monthly.
Must not have previously received TPSPDT or assistance from the Zarith Sofiah
Education Financial Assistance initiative.
No age limit.
Funding Details
Financial assistance for B40 students pursuing Master's studies.
Supports coursework, research and mixed-mode programmes.
Recipients are required to participate in PDT research, education and CSR
programmes for five years.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
One-off postgraduate educational grant (non-repayable).
Official Sources:
https://www.pdt.com.my/
