records.title: Bantuan Ke Institusi Pengajian Tinggi (IPT)
records.description:
Financial assistance provided by the Melaka State Government through
TAPEM.
Supports Melaka-born students and other applicants who qualify under
TAPEM's definition of Anak Negeri Melaka.
Intended to reduce the financial burden associated with starting higher
education.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Applicant must be born in Melaka.
Applicant's mother or father must be born in Melaka.
Applicant must reside in Melaka.
Applicant must be a registered voter in Melaka.
Applicant must have received an offer and registered at an IPT.
Application must be submitted within six months of IPT registration.
Assistance is available for first-time enrolment at each respective study level.
Special consideration may apply to applicants who were not born in Melaka
but have resided in Melaka for more than 10 years, subject to supporting
documents and TAPEM approval.
Funding Details
Financial contribution to help students cover initial higher education expenses.
Awarded once for each study level.
Students may apply when progressing to a new study level, subject to
eligibility.
Students can study at eligible public or private higher education institutions
(IPT) in Malaysia.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
One-off financial assistance.
Non-repayable education assistance.
Available for first-time enrolment at each study level only.
Official Sources:
Official programme information: https://tapem.melaka.gov.my/bantuan-ke-institusi-pengajian-tinggi

Provider: Tabung Amanah Pendidikan Negeri Melaka (TAPEM), Government of
Melaka
Title: Bantuan Ke Institusi Pengajian Tinggi (IPT)
Deadline / Application Period:
Applications are accepted within six months from the student's official IPT
registration date.
No single annual closing date is specified on the official application page.
Application portal is available online.
For 2026, confirm the current intake and application status with TAPEM before
submission.
Funding Amount:
Diploma: RM400
Bachelor's Degree: RM600
Master's Degree: RM600
PhD: RM600
UNIMEL and MiCoST students (all study levels): RM1,000
Funding Type:
One-off financial assistance.
Non-repayable education assistance.
Available for first-time enrolment at each study level only.
Funding Information:
Financial contribution to help students cover initial higher education expenses.
Awarded once for each study level.
Students may apply when progressing to a new study level, subject to
eligibility.
Students can study at eligible public or private higher education institutions
(IPT) in Malaysia.
Description:
Financial assistance provided by the Melaka State Government through
TAPEM.
Supports Melaka-born students and other applicants who qualify under
TAPEM's definition of Anak Negeri Melaka.
Intended to reduce the financial burden associated with starting higher
education.
Eligibility Criteria:
Applicant must be born in Melaka.
Applicant's mother or father must be born in Melaka.
Applicant must reside in Melaka.
Applicant must be a registered voter in Melaka.
Applicant must have received an offer and registered at an IPT.
Application must be submitted within six months of IPT registration.
Assistance is available for first-time enrolment at each respective study level.
Special consideration may apply to applicants who were not born in Melaka
but have resided in Melaka for more than 10 years, subject to supporting
documents and TAPEM approval.
Link:
Official programme information: https://tapem.melaka.gov.my/bantuan-ke-institusi-pengajian-tinggi

records.title: Skim Bantuan Awal IPT (Yayasan Wilayah Persekutuan)
records.description:
Financial assistance provided by Yayasan Wilayah Persekutuan.
Specifically intended for students from low-income families in the Federal
Territories.
Supports students who have successfully secured admission into higher
education institutions.
Available to eligible Kuala Lumpur residents.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen.
Born and residing in the Federal Territories (Kuala Lumpur, Putrajaya or
Labuan).
Must satisfy the applicable Federal Territories voter registration requirements:
Applicants aged 21 and above must be registered voters in the Federal
Territories.
For applicants aged 21 and below, their parent or guardian must be a
Federal Territories voter.
Family per capita income must not exceed RM1,000 per month, according to
the published application conditions.
Must be in the first semester of the first year of study.
Must be enrolled in a full-time Diploma, Bachelor's Degree, Master's Degree
or PhD programme.
Must have an offer from a recognised IPTA or IPTS.
Funding Details
Financial assistance for students entering public or private higher education
institutions.
Intended to cover initial education expenses, including:
Registration fees.
Learning materials.
Basic living expenses.
Awarded once to successful applicants.
Students may study at IPTs inside or outside Kuala Lumpur, subject to
programme conditions.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
One-off financial assistance.
Non-repayable education assistance.
Official Sources:
Official programme page: https://www.yayasanwp.org/skim-bantuan-awal

records.title: Hadiah Pengajian Institut Pengajian Tinggi (HPIPT) Selangor / Iltizam Mahasiswa Selangor
records.description:
Financial assistance provided by the Selangor State Government.
Supports students from low-income Selangor households entering higher
education.
Helps reduce the financial burden of beginning tertiary education.
Not a scholarship or education loan.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Applicant, mother and father must be Malaysian citizens.
Must qualify as an Anak Selangor through one of these conditions:
Applicant was born and resides in Selangor; OR
Applicant's mother or father was born and resides in Selangor; OR
Applicant has resided and attended school in Selangor for at least 11
years, while at least one parent has also resided in Selangor for at least
11 years.
Must be enrolled full-time in a government-recognised IPTA or IPTS.
Must be in the first year of study.
Must possess an SPM certificate.
Household income must not exceed RM5,000 per month.
Must have registered at the IPT before applying.
Applicants who have previously received HPIPT are not eligible to receive it
again.
Funding Details
RM1,000 cash assistance per successful applicant.
Intended to cover initial higher education expenses.
Applicable to recognised public and private IPTs throughout Malaysia.
Limited to first-year students.
Only 3,000 successful recipients are targeted annually.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
One-off financial assistance.
Non-repayable education grant.
Awarded only once throughout the student's entire period of study,
regardless of whether they progress from Diploma to Bachelor's Degree.
Official Sources:
https://ehpipt.selangor.gov.my/hpipt/register
Official Sources:
https://danapendidikan.selangor.gov.my/syarat-syarat-hpipt

records.title: Program Bantuan Yuran Pengajian (BYP) Institusi Pengajian Tinggi Awam dan Swasta bagi Pelajar Komuniti India B40
records.description:
Financial assistance provided by the Selangor State Government.
Specifically designed to support students from the B40 Indian community.
Initially introduced for children of plantation workers before being expanded
to other eligible B40 Indian students.
Supports students pursuing Diploma and Bachelor's Degree programmes.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen.
Must be of Indian ethnicity.
Must qualify as a Selangor resident through at least one of these conditions:
Applicant was born in Selangor; OR
Applicant's mother or father was born in Selangor; OR
Applicant has resided in Selangor for at least 15 years.
Must be enrolled in a government-recognised IPTA or IPTS anywhere in
Malaysia.
Household income must not exceed RM2,000 per month.
Must provide supporting documents and meet the programme's approval
requirements.
Funding Details
Financial contribution towards higher education tuition fees.
Available for students enrolled in recognised public and private IPTs
throughout Malaysia.
Payment is made through a cheque or Electronic Fund Transfer (EFT) to the
institution.
Intended to reduce the financial burden of tuition fees.
Awarded as a one-off contribution per eligible student.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
One-off financial assistance.
Non-repayable education fee contribution.
Payment is made directly to the student's IPT.
Official Sources:
https://dewan.selangor.gov.my/question/bantuan-pelajar-lepasan-spm/

records.title: Geran Pra Siswazah & Pasca Siswazah (Geran Bantuan Pelajar ke IPT)
records.description:
Financial assistance provided by the Pahang State Government through
Yayasan Pahang.
Established to support Pahang students who successfully pursue higher
education.
Helps students manage initial education-related expenses.
Available for studies ranging from Certificate to Doctoral level.
Not a scholarship or education loan.
records.eligibility_criteria:
General requirements:
Malaysian citizen.
Must qualify as Anak Negeri Pahang through one of the following:
Applicant, mother or father was born in Pahang; OR
If applicant and both parents were born outside Pahang, applicant
must have resided in Pahang for more than 10 years and intend to
continue residing there.
Must provide an official residency confirmation letter from the Penghulu,
District Officer or authorised representative of Yayasan Pahang.
Applicant's correspondence address must be in Pahang.
Applicant's parents must be Malaysian citizens.
Must study full-time at a recognised IPT approved by Yayasan Pahang.
Pre-Graduate category:
Must hold SPM, STPM or STAM qualifications, depending on the programme.
Must be entering higher education for the first time.
Must apply within the specified registration period.
Post-Graduate category:
Must have received an offer for a full-time Master's or PhD programme in the
current academic year.
Must meet Yayasan Pahang's academic and institution requirements.
Must apply within the specified registration period.
Funding Details
RM700 for Pre-Graduate studies.
RM1,200 for Post-Graduate studies.
Payment is made once to successful applicants.
Available for full-time studies at IPTs approved by Yayasan Pahang.
Applicable to selected public and private higher education institutions
throughout Malaysia.
The institution must be included in Yayasan Pahang's approved IPT list.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
One-off financial assistance.
Non-repayable education grant.
Applicants may apply once under each eligible category:
Pre-graduate category: Once.
Post-graduate category: Once.
Students who have received the pre-graduate grant at Foundation,
Matriculation, Tamhidi or Diploma level cannot apply again for the Bachelor's
Degree grant.
Official Sources:
https://www.yp.org.my

records.title: Yayasan Perak – Insentif Siswa Yayasan Perak (INSISYP)
records.description:
Helps students cover initial higher education expenses.
Intended to ease the financial burden of students and families during their
first-year, first-semester registration.
Available for selected recognised local and overseas institutions.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen.
Applicant, mother or father must meet the Perak birth or residency
requirements.
Must be at least 18 years old, with specified exceptions for vocational
students.
Household monthly basic income must not exceed RM7,500.
Must be a first-year, first-semester full-time student.
Must apply within four months of IPT registration.
Overseas applicants must study at institutions recognised by JPA and MQA.
Funding Details
Financial assistance provided by Yayasan Perak.
Awarded once per student for each eligible study level.
Overseas funding varies according to the destination country's category.
Domestic funding applies to eligible households with monthly income of
RM7,500 or below.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Education Financial Assistance (One-off Grant)
Additional Information
Application opening information:
1 January 2026

records.title: Bantuan Awal Kemasukan ke Institusi Pengajian Tinggi (BAKIPT)
records.description:
Financial assistance provided by the Kedah State Government.
Administered by Seksyen Pembiayaan Pendidikan Negeri Kedah (SPPNK).
Supports newly enrolled students from Kedah who require financial assistance
to begin higher education.
Helps cover initial registration fees, books and basic educational expenses.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen.
Applicant, mother or father must have been born in Kedah.
Applicant must currently reside and be domiciled in Kedah.
Residence must correspond with the address stated in the IPT admission
documentation.
Must be enrolled in the first semester of a new intake in the application year.
Must be studying full-time.
Household gross monthly income must not exceed RM5,249.
Must have paid the initial registration fee or possess an official acceptance
confirmation.
Must be enrolled in one of the eligible study levels.
Postgraduate, part-time and off-campus students are not eligible.
Previous BAKIPT recipients cannot apply again at the same study level.
Funding Details
RM300 cash assistance per successful applicant.
Intended to cover initial higher education expenses.
Payment is made through the applicant's DUN Service Centre or DUN
Coordinator.
Applicable to eligible full-time students at recognised public and private IPTs.
Students may study at institutions inside or outside Malaysia, subject to
recognition requirements.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
One-off financial assistance.
Non-repayable education grant.
Awarded only once throughout the entire study period at each different study
level.
Official Sources:
https://eservices.kedah.gov.my/ibakipt

records.title: Bantuan Pendaftaran Pelajar ke Institut Pengajian Tinggi (iBITA)
records.description:
Financial assistance provided by the Penang State Government.
Helps students from Penang manage the financial burden of entering higher
education.
Supports eligible students who have received offers from recognised public or
private higher education institutions.
This is an initial registration grant, not a scholarship or education loan.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen.
Applicant must fulfil at least one of these conditions:
Born in Penang; OR
Obtained SPM or STPM from a school in Penang, with at least one
parent or guardian registered as a Penang voter.
Must have received an offer for a full-time Diploma or Bachelor's Degree
programme.
Must be entering the relevant study level during the eligible intake.
Household basic salary (parents or guardians) must not exceed RM8,000 per
month.
Must provide the official IPT offer letter and supporting documents.
Applicants can only receive assistance once at Diploma level and once at
Bachelor's Degree level.
Funding Details
RM1,000 for eligible university students studying in Peninsular Malaysia.
RM1,200 for eligible university students studying in Sabah or Sarawak.
RM300 for eligible Polytechnic Malaysia students.
Intended to cover initial registration and enrolment expenses.
Available for eligible students entering Diploma or Bachelor's Degree
programmes.
Students may study outside Penang, including other Malaysian states.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
One-off financial assistance.
Non-repayable registration grant.
Awarded once throughout the entire study period at the respective study
level.
Official Sources:
https://ibita.penang.gov.my/

records.title: Sumbangan Dana Pendidikan Kerajaan Negeri Perlis
records.description:
Financial assistance provided by the Perlis State Government.
Established to help students from Perlis pursue higher education.
Unlike zakat assistance, the programme is designed for both Muslim and non-
Muslim applicants.
Intended to reduce the initial financial burden of entering IPT.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen.
Must qualify as an eligible student from Perlis.
Must have received an offer to pursue higher education.
Must be enrolled in an eligible public or private IPT.
Must meet the programme's application and supporting-document
requirements.
Specific 2026 residency, income and study-level requirements need
confirmation from the state government.
Funding Details
Financial contribution to help students prepare for higher education.
Intended for initial university enrolment and education expenses.
Supports students entering public and private higher education institutions.
Students may pursue their studies outside Perlis.
Applications are submitted to the Perlis State Secretary's Office.
Muslim applicants' payments were historically coordinated through MAIPs,
while non-Muslim applicants could receive assistance through the state
government.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
One-off financial assistance.
Non-repayable education contribution.
Open to Muslim and non-Muslim students.
Not a scholarship or education loan.
Official Sources:
https://www.perlis.gov.my/

records.title: Bantuan Persediaan Yayasan Terengganu (BPYT) – University Category (IPTA/IPTS)
records.description:
A state-funded financial assistance programme designed to reduce the
financial burden of Terengganu students entering higher education.
Helps students manage initial expenses associated with starting their studies.
The assistance is provided as a one-time payment rather than a recurring
allowance or education loan.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Applicant must be a Malaysian citizen and qualify as an Anak Negeri
Terengganu.
At least one parent or guardian must:
Be born in Terengganu; OR
Have been a permanent resident of Terengganu for more than 10
years, supported by an official residency declaration.
Parent or guardian must be a registered voter in a Terengganu state
constituency (DUN).
Must be enrolled in a full-time programme.
Applicant must not be employed.
Institution must be government-recognised and the programme must have
MQA recognition where applicable.
Minimum programme duration: one year.
Age requirements:
Certificate / Diploma / Bachelor's / Master's: 25 years old or below.
PhD: 30 years old or below.
Assistance can only be received once at each level of study.
Funding Details
Financial assistance provided to eligible Terengganu students before or at the
beginning of their higher education journey.
Covers certificate, diploma, bachelor's, master's and PhD levels.
Available for eligible public and private higher education institutions.
Each applicant can receive the assistance only once at each level of study.
Applications are submitted online through Yayasan Terengganu's official
system.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
One-off financial assistance.
Non-repayable.
Intended to help students cover their initial higher education expenses.
Official Sources:
https://bp.yt.gov.my/

records.title: Bantuan Tunai Pendaftaran IPT Secara One-Off (BUDI)
records.description:
A financial assistance initiative introduced by the Sabah State Government to
support students entering higher education for the first time.
Designed to reduce the financial burden of initial university registration and
enrolment costs.
Specifically targets students from lower- and middle-income households.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Malaysian citizen.
Must be of Sabah Bumiputera origin.
Must belong to the B40 or M40 household income categories.
Must be entering an IPT for the first time in the 2026 intake.
Must enrol in a full-time programme.
Must receive an offer and confirmation of registration from a recognised IPTA
or IPTS.
Applicable to institutions in Malaysia or overseas.
Applicants must provide supporting documents, including:
Applicant's birth certificate.
Parents' birth certificates.
Applicant's and parents' identification cards.
Parents' salary slips or employment-status confirmation.
University offer letter.
Confirmation of university registration.
Funding Details
Intended to help students and their families cover initial higher education
registration expenses.
Available for first-time full-time enrolment into recognised higher education
institutions.
Applicable to institutions in Malaysia and overseas.
Assistance is paid once for the eligible admission.
Applications must be submitted online.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
One-off financial assistance.
Non-repayable cash assistance.
Provided by the Sabah State Government.
Official Sources:
https://budi.sabah.gov.my/

records.title: Higher Education Entry Assistance (Bantuan Kemasukan ke IPT)
records.description:
Financial assistance for financially disadvantaged Muslim students
entering higher education.
Intended to reduce the financial burden of starting a new academic
programme.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Sarawakian Muslim or a Malaysian citizen residing in
Sarawak.
Must have an official offer letter from a recognised higher education
institution.
Must be enrolled full-time.
Application is for Semester 1, Year 1.
Must not receive monthly salary or financial support from an employer
amounting to half or more of their monthly salary.
Assistance is subject to Tabung Baitulmal Sarawak's assessment and
approval.
Funding Details
Provided once for each level of study.
Covers financial needs associated with initial university registration.
Available for recognised higher education institutions in Malaysia and
overseas.
Administered through zakat funds.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
Non-repayable, one-off financial assistance.
Official Sources:
https://www.tbs.org.my/

records.title: Hadiah Galakan ke IPT (Higher Education Encouragement Award)
records.description:
A one-time financial incentive for Sarawakian students enrolling in higher
education.
Supports students during their transition into tertiary education.
Separate from recurring monthly allowances and education loans.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Sarawakian.
Either the applicant or at least one parent must be born in Sarawak or hold a
Sarawak identification card.
Must be enrolled in a full-time Diploma or Bachelor's Degree programme.
Programme must be recognised by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency
(MQA).
Only applicable to first-time enrolment at each study level.
Part-time and distance-learning students are not eligible.
Applicants receiving full sponsorship may be excluded.
Funding Details
Intended to encourage Sarawakian students to pursue higher education.
Supports students entering recognised Diploma and Bachelor's Degree
programmes.
Designed to help reduce the initial financial burden of higher education.
Available for eligible public and private higher education institutions.
Additional Information
Published funding type:
One-off financial assistance.
Non-repayable education incentive.
Not a scholarship or education loan.
Official Sources:
https://myys.yayasansarawak.org.my/
